summary: Blooming Grove is an unincorporated community in northeastern North Bloomfield Township, Morrow County, Ohio. It sits at the junction of State Route 97 and Morrow County Road 20. The note also gives its location relative to nearby Galion and the county seat, Mount Gilead.
one_line: Blooming Grove is an unincorporated community in Morrow County, Ohio, located at the junction of State Routes 97 and County Road 20.
key_facts: Blooming Grove is an unincorporated community in northeastern North Bloomfield Township, Morrow County, Ohio, United States.
Blooming Grove is located at the junction of State Route 97 and Morrow County Road 20.
The nearest city to Blooming Grove is Galion, Ohio, located to the northwest.
Mount Gilead is the county seat of Morrow County.
Mount Gilead is located southwest of Blooming Grove on State Route 61.
